BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced on April 30, 2026, that it purchased 923,243 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The purchases were made from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026. The highest price paid per share was 886.8000 pence, the lowest was 869.0000 pence, and the volume-weighted average price paid was 878.0023 pence. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 30 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
